import sys

data = list(map(int, sys.stdin.buffer.read().split()))
n = data[0]
s = ''.join(map(str, data[1:]))

for length in range(1, n + 1):
    if s[0] == '0':
        break

    start = s[:length]
    value = int(start)
    pos = length

    while pos < n:
        value += 1
        nxt = str(value)
        if not s.startswith(nxt, pos):
            break
        pos += len(nxt)

    if pos == n:
        print(start)
        break
